column1: # EVAL_SPEC for ovx/slurm/eval.sbatch: line i holds the `ovx/run.sh eval` options for array task i,
# in the same order as the DATASETS of the training array. Blank lines and comments are skipped.
# --model is a run directory under /home/ovx/checkpoints, --data-dir a LeRobot root under
# episodes provide the starting states. Prefer held-out episodes that were not used in training.
# CHECK BEFORE USE: the env id of each dataset (carry_totes in particular) and --sim-mode, which
# must match the renderer the training videos came from (mujoco or mujoco_isaac).
